APPROVE
The extracted helpers keep every check in its original order, including the `const`/`let` local recording happening before the payload and `return` checks; the added `k > 0` guard is always true because `k` starts at `body.Start + 1`; `AnswersOnlyConstants` drops to roughly 4, and nothing in the diff should raise a build warning, though I reviewed it by reading rather than compiling.
